purpose: A zero-training fixed-pose parity gate between Open3D CPU synthetic LiDAR and Gazebo Classic CPU ray LiDAR on identical sealed Cano train geometry.

approval.scope: One implementation and one execution using 3 train parents, 24 fixed poses, 24 CPU references and 72 Gazebo repeat scans; no formal dataset or training.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the exact 3-parent, 24-pose, 24 CPU-reference, 72 Gazebo-repeat, zero-training parity scope.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research execution; sealed Cano OBJ assets are read-only and upstream source is not redistributed.
source.benchmark_exclusion: Only S01/S06/S10 C01 train parents are used. M-TARE benchmark, validation and development-test worlds are excluded.

generation.retry_policy: One full run after approval; stop and seal at first failure, with no alternate parent, pose, seed, backend or retry.
generation.variant_policy: Read exact M1R OBJ bytes in both backends; no regeneration, conversion, repair, simplification or navigation qualification.

sampling.sensor_contract: Open3D and Gazebo CPU first-return 16x720, elevations -15:2:15 degrees, azimuth 0:0.5:359.5 degrees, 0.3--50m, 0.001m resolution, no noise.
sampling.label_contract: No semantic or training label is generated; role and graph/spline provenance exist only to stratify parity metrics.
sampling.storage_contract: Diagnostic-only paired shards: 24 CPU references plus three Gazebo repeats per pose, complete figures and manifests; none may enter a formal dataset.

evidence.machine_metrics: Require analytic box control, exact source/container/plugin identities, frame/ring/raster checks, three-scan Gazebo repeatability and frozen per-pose valid/range thresholds.
evidence.complete_visual_review: One full pose map, one analytic-control figure and six fixed four-pose pages cover every pair exactly once; no best-case selection.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop and seal on first failure; do not change thresholds, pose, geometry, backend or sensor noise inside the run.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only Open3D and a fresh isolated Gazebo Classic 11.10.2 gzserver container; no GUI/GPU/training.
